chunks: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and ask: 'Where are My compeers for whom you contended?' Those endowed with knowledge will say: 'Shame and evil surely are for unbelievers today.'
ai.seo_question: What do those endowed with knowledge say about the disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah An-Nahl, Allah confronts polytheists on the Day of Resurrection, asking where their false partners are, to which they find no answer. The response of 'those endowed with knowledge' (Ahl al-Ilm) underscores the Shia emphasis on the certainty of the learned regarding divine truth, declaring that shame and evil befall the disbelievers. This highlights the contrast between the confusion of the polytheists and the clarity of the knowledgeable.
